result.title: When Should AI Agents Ask? Clarification Requests Under Limited Human Attention
result.summary: AI agents increasingly carry out delegated tasks in parallel, with one person overseeing several of them at once. In practice, an agent often lacks information its task requires, such as an unstated preference, constraint, or specification. It can ask the human to clarify, or it can search for the information itself, for example in past records, which takes time and effort and may fail. In this paper, we study how to coordinate these decisions across several agents that share one human with limited attention. We build a stylized model in which each agent can search, ask, or continue the parts of its task that do not depend on the missing information, and we formulate the problem as a dynamic program. We first show that whether an agent should ask depends on more than its own uncertainty: an agent with other work to do can be better off asking earlier, and which question the human should answer first depends on all waiting questions, so no ranking computed agent by agent is optimal. We then propose the Pairwise Coordination Policy (PCP), which uses exact one- and two-task problems to estimate how pairs of tasks delay each other when they share the human. Theoretically, PCP is exactly optimal when at most two requirements remain unresolved and costs at most twice the optimum when every unresolved requirement must be resolved by the human. We evaluate PCP on 864 synthetic cases and in a case study with LLM agents. On the synthetic benchmark, PCP's mean gap to optimal cost is 0.07%, and it reduces cost by an average of 18-31% relative to three standard rules for when to ask. In the LLM case study, agents completed every task correctly, and PCP achieved the lowest mean cost in all tested settings.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多个 AI agent 共享一个注意力有限的人类时如何决定「自行检索、向人提问、还是先做不依赖缺失信息的部分」，将其建为动态规划问题，并提出基于双任务精确求解的 Pairwise Coordination Policy（PCP），在合成基准与 LLM 案例中评估成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「检索／提问／继续」三类动作与共享注意力预算的建模，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 与 STOP 的收益—成本权衡、外部证据获取顺序提供问题表述与评价线索；但该设定无视觉输入与 latent 状态，迁移性需核查。
